purpose: Bounded read evidence for the D02 CRISM spectral-detection pilot. Raw window bytes were never written to Git.

access.method: HTTPS byte-range GET on the official PDS Geosciences Node product
access.range_support: accept-ranges: bytes on every requested asset
access.note: Only metadata, the 60-band refined summary window, the 9-band DP window and the band subsets needed by the two documented parameters were read.

assets.name: hrl000040ff_07_if183j_mtr3.img
assets.geometry: 455 samples x 751 lines x 489 bands, BSQ float32

band_semantics.header_table_agreement: 489 header wavelengths; every header wavelength appears in the TAB and the header preserves ascending order except at the three documented gaps

corner_check.note: Recomputed values reproduce the label's corner coordinates to the printed precision; the 18 m residual is half a 36 m pixel between edge and pixel-centre conventions.

dp_mask_band.name: VNIR/IR Mask
dp_mask_band.interpretation: 0 observed; the MTRDR SIS bit definition was not validated here, so the mask is not used as a quality filter.

reproduction_attempt.method: Viviano-Beck et al. (2014) Table 2, parameters 38 (D2300) and 14 (OLINDEX3), median kernels of 3/5/7 bands
reproduction_attempt.interpretation: Agreement is far outside 0.001 and D2300 correlation is not consistently positive. The cause is not resolved: candidate causes are the exact band-to-wavelength kernel mapping (the TAB lists detector channel order, not band order), the source cube used for the SR product (IF versus Lambert albedo), and the CRISM destriping/flattening step applied before summary products. No detected/not-detected state can be emitted.

official_context_only.note: Values read from the official refined-summary product inside the two read sub-windows. They are context, not a detection by this repository.

blockers.summary: Exact band-index kernels for the summary parameters are unresolved
blockers.detail: The header wavelength vector is ascending but the TAB is detector-order (VNIR ascending, IR descending). Nearest-wavelength kernels reproduced neither D2300 nor OLINDEX3 within tolerance.
blockers.resolution_required: Map each Table 2 reference wavelength to the exact product band index used by the CRISM pipeline, then re-run the reproduction check.

blockers.summary: The cube and preprocessing used for the shipped summary product are not confirmed
blockers.detail: The label exposes IF and Lambert-albedo products plus a destriping/flattening step described in Viviano-Beck et al. (2014) section 4.4/5; this pilot applied neither.
blockers.resolution_required: Confirm the input cube and implement the documented median/destriping step before comparing to the official summary bands.

blockers.detail: Explicit pilot thresholds (D2300 > 0.02, OLINDEX3 > 0.10) are recorded but are not applied because the decoder is unvalidated and published thresholds are scene-dependent.
blockers.resolution_required: Validate a detector against labelled CRISM type spectra or published per-scene thresholds before emitting mineral states.

blockers.summary: DP information-map bit definitions not validated
blockers.detail: The VNIR/IR mask read as 0 in all sampled pixels, but no SIS bit table was verified, so it cannot yet serve as a quality filter.
blockers.resolution_required: Pin the MTRDR SIS DP mask bit table and test it on a scene with known masked pixels.
